name: CreateJobMonitorRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to obtain the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 迁移、同步或订阅任务ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html获取
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the alert metric. Valid values:
delay: the Latency metric.
error: the Migration Status metric.
full_timeout: the Full Migration Duration metric.

Default value: error. This parameter must be manually specified
parameters.help_zh:
监控项的类型，取值：
delay：延迟监控项。
error：迁移状态监控项。
full_timeout：全量运行耗时监控项。

默认值：error；需手动填入
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the alert rule. Valid values:

Y: Enable the alert rule.
N: Disable the alert rule.

Default value: Y
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用告警规则，取值：

Y：启用。
N：不启用。

默认值：Y
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone numbers of alert contacts, separated by commas (,).
This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com) and only for the Chinese mainland mobile phone numbers. A maximum of 10 mobile phone numbers can be specified.
The international site does not support SMS-based alerting. You can only https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175876.html
parameters.help_zh:
告警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。
本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持中国内地手机号码，且最多传入10个手机号码。
国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175876.html
parameters.name: phone

parameters.help_en:
The threshold for triggering an alert.

If Type is set to delay, the unit is seconds and the value must be an integer. Set the threshold based on your business requirements. A value of 10 or greater is recommended to avoid alert fluctuations caused by network issues or database loads.

If Type is set to full_timeout, the unit is hours and the value must be an integer.

This parameter is required when Type is set to delay or full_timeout and State is set to Y
parameters.help_zh:
触发告警的阈值。

当Type取值为delay时，单位为秒且需为整数，可根据业务需要设置阈值，建议设置10秒以上，避免因网络、数据库负载等原因导致的延迟波动。

当Type取值为full_timeout时，单位为小时且需为整数。

当Type取值为delay或full_timeout且State取值为Y时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: delay_rule_time

parameters.help_en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS实例所属的地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The statistical period of the incremental verification task. Unit: minutes.

Valid values: 1, 5, 10, and 30
parameters.help_zh:
增量校验任务的统计周期，单位为分钟。

当前支持取值为1分钟、5分钟、10分钟和30分钟
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The number of statistical periods for the incremental verification task
parameters.help_zh: 增量校验任务的周期数
parameters.name: times
